summary_short.zh: AGENTS.md 是一个开源规范，为AI编程助手提供标准化指导格式，解决复杂开发任务中指令不一致的问题。它通过Markdown结构化定义任务上下文、步骤和约束，让AI代理能更好地理解意图、分解问题并保持会话连续性。其核心在于将模糊需求转化为可执行的指导框架，开发者可创建可复用的模板来处理API集成或代码重构等常见场景。尝试在TypeScript项目中应用此格式，你会发现结构化提示能显著提升AI协作的可靠性和效率。

summaries.en: AGENTS.md is an open specification that provides a standardized way to guide AI coding assistants through complex development tasks. It works by defining clear, structured instructions in markdown format that help agents understand context, break down problems, and maintain consistency across sessions. Developers can use it to create reusable agent templates for common workflows like API integration or refactoring, making AI-assisted coding more predictable and collaborative. Try implementing it in your TypeScript projects to see how structured prompts improve agent performance.

summary_short.zh: AionUi是一款免费、本地化、开源的界面工具，旨在整合多种AI编程助手（如Gemini CLI、Claude Code、Codex等），解决开发者需频繁切换不同工具的繁琐问题。它通过统一的操作环境，让用户能在一个平台内调用多个AI模型，无需单独配置每个服务。技术上，该项目基于TypeScript开发，注重模块化设计，便于扩展新的AI工具集成。开发者可将其部署在本地环境中，用于代码生成、调试辅助或学习编程，通过对比不同AI的输出结果来优化工作流程，适合探索AI编程助手实际应用的实验场景。

summaries.en: AionUi is a free, local, open-source interface that simplifies working with multiple AI coding assistants like Gemini CLI, Claude Code, and Codex. It provides a unified environment where developers can seamlessly switch between different AI tools without managing separate setups. You can install it locally to experiment with various coding assistants, compare their outputs, and integrate them into your development workflow for tasks like code generation, debugging, or learning new programming concepts.

summary_short.zh: Gentleman.Dots 是针对 LazyVim 的个人配置项目，旨在通过预置设置和插件优化编程工作流。该项目采用模块化设计，集成社区插件，将文本编辑器转变为类 IDE 环境，平衡开箱即用的便利性与高度可定制性。用户可克隆仓库快速搭建个性化 Vim 环境，并通过修改配置文件增删插件、调整快捷键，根据编程语言和习惯深度定制，适合希望提升编辑效率但不愿从零配置的 Vim 用户。

summaries.zh: Gentleman.Dots 是针对 LazyVim 的个人配置项目，旨在通过预置设置和插件优化编程工作流。该项目采用模块化设计，集成社区插件，将文本编辑器转变为类 IDE 环境，平衡开箱即用的便利性与高度可定制性。用户可克隆仓库快速搭建个性化 Vim 环境，并通过修改配置文件增删插件、调整快捷键，根据编程语言和习惯深度定制，适合希望提升编辑效率但不愿从零配置的 Vim 用户。
summaries.en: Gentleman.Dots is a personal configuration setup for LazyVim, a modern Neovim distribution, that helps developers streamline their coding workflow by providing pre-configured settings and plugins. It demonstrates how thoughtful configuration can transform a text editor into a powerful IDE-like environment through modular design and community-driven plugin integration. Developers can clone this repository to quickly bootstrap their own customized Vim environment, then modify the configuration files to add or remove plugins, adjust key mappings, and tailor the setup to their specific programming languages and workflows.
